items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Buddy P.T., Gus Madcat, Chris Kelly, whoever would get a parade or get an advertisement, get that gig, we'd play.

ctx.x: And you used a B clarinet on A clarinet? No, no, I used to use a C. I had a C. C and parades. Yeah, that's right. Who did you work with on the street? Some of the different bands?
Buddy, Gus. Buddy P.T.? Buddy P.T., Gus Madcat, Chris Kelly, whoever would get a parade or get an advertisement, get that gig, we'd play. Sure.
Do you have anything you want to tell the people in particular? Any advice to young clarinetists maybe?
